text:
nina: Heads-up from encrypt-audit-lambda: it flagged ~18 snapshots uploaded yesterday without ServerSideEncryption set (prod-backups/db/2026-03-19/*).

omar: How did encrypt-audit detect them? false positives?

nina: Lambda scans HeadObject response for ServerSideEncryption header and compares to metadata whitelist. These keys return no SSE header and size matches DB snapshot pattern. Double-checked checksums.

sam: backup-agent v2.3.0 logic: attempt KMS encrypt; on error falls back to plain PutObject (legacy behavior). I thought we changed that in 2.3.1?

omar: We rolled role-switching to role-permissions-service at 01:40 UTC (deploy ops_priya/role-swap). Could be a transient IAM propagation issue. ops-bot: can you show deploy event?

ops-bot: Deploy event: role-swap (PR #4199) merged 2026-03-19T01:38:12Z, rollout completed 01:43:07Z. No rollbacks.

nina: Timeline: backup jobs ran 01:50, 02:50, 03:50 UTC. encrypt-audit shows first missing SSE at 01:50 window.

sam: Log snippet from backup-wn-07: 
```
2026-03-19T01:50:12Z ERROR backup-agent kms.go:87 kms.Encrypt: AccessDeniedException: user arn:aws:sts::acct:assumed-role/backup-role/... is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/kkk-lll-mmm
2026-03-19T01:50:12Z WARN s3_uploader.go:210 continuing upload without SSE (config.allow_unencrypted_uploads=true)
```

nina: That allow_unencrypted_uploads flag is the problem. We should never default to true in prod.

omar: Agreed. Immediate containment: 1) list all objects without SSE under prod-backups prefix, 2) add temporary bucket policy to deny GetObject on unencrypted snapshots until we assess, 3) copy objects to encrypted prefix or delete if duplicates exist. Who can run list+head scan?

sam: I can run the scan and produce a CSV (key, size, etag, uploader-host). ETA 20m. In parallel I'll prepare a hotfix to change behavior to fail upload on KMS errors (and emit metric encryption.failure.kms_access_denied).

ops-bot: S3 access logs available from 2026-03-19. Starting log ingestion job.

nina: For containment, rather than deny GetObject (which could break restores), add a bucket policy to deny PutObject without SSE and add an IAM SCP to prevent future role-swap misconfig. Also create a temporary IAM condition to prevent reads from anonymous principals.

omar: Example deny PutObject w/o header (will test in staging): 
```json
{
  "Sid": "DenyUnEncryptedUploads",
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Principal": "*",
  "Action": "s3:PutObject",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::prod-backups/*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringNotEquals": {"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms"}
  }
}
```

sam: That prevents future bad uploads. For existing objects I propose copying to s3://prod-backups/quarantine/<tenant>/... with --sse aws:kms then updating inventory to point to new keys. Copy command I tested: `aws s3 cp s3://prod-backups/db/tenant17/20260319.snap s3://prod-backups/quarantine/db/tenant17/20260319.snap --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/kkk-lll-mmm`

nina: Good. Also run SIEM query for any GetObject matching affected keys since 2026-03-19T01:30Z: `eventName = "GetObject" AND startswith(requestParameters.key, "db/") AND serverSideEncryption = null`

legal: tagging in case customers need notif. please include tenant ids and whether snapshot contents could be reconstructed externally.

omar: Sam's CSV will include tenant ids. Also check CloudTrail KMS events: was anyone calling kms:Decrypt on that key for those snapshots?

sam: CSV done: 18 keys across 2 tenants (tenant17, tenant88). Hosts: backup-wn-07/08/09. Sizes 1.2G-3.1G. Upload timestamps align with 01:50-03:50 UTC windows.

nina: Running SIEM now. No GetObject events for those keys found after upload window. CloudTrail shows kms:Encrypt denied calls from backup-role at 01:50. No kms:Decrypt calls.

omar: That reduces immediate exposure risk but we should still quarantine and change agent behavior.

sam: Hotfix branch open: `fix/abort-on-kms-deny`. Tests added. Requesting expedited review from infra.

omar: Ops: revert role-swap (PR #4199) or roll forward with a fix to ensure role-permissions service returns role before backup-agent starts. We need gating so agents don't start until IAM attach confirmed.

nina: Post-incident actions: 1) enforce prod config: allow_unencrypted_uploads=false, 2) bucket policy deny PutObject without SSE, 3) agent metric + alert on encryption.failure.kms_access_denied, 4) deploy gate for role attach, 5) run a full audit for past 90 days for unencrypted objects.

legal: hold on comms until we have full SIEM result and customer list. If no reads, we likely treat as "no evidence of access" but still notify impacted customers per policy.

sam: Starting copy to quarantine (smallest first). Will update ticket with progress.

omar: I'll schedule rollback window with ops_priya in 15m.

nina: Thanks team. Keep updates in the incident ticket INC-20260319-0071.
